## Decisions

- **Explicitly granted sequence usage on agent_audit_log_id_seq to authenticated**: The id column is `generated always as identity`; without the sequence grant the first insert succeeds as owner but later inserts under the authenticated role fail on nextval permission. Caught by reading the generated DDL rather than assuming the table grant was sufficient.
- **No insert/update/delete policy on digests, and no update/delete policy on agent_audit_log**: Audit trail and digests are written server-side only; a client-facing write policy would let a caller forge history. Absence of a policy is the enforcement, not an omission.
- **Duplicated the group-by columns explicitly instead of relying on grouping by primary key**: Spec groups by e.id / b.id only. Grouping by the PK is sufficient in Postgres, but listing the columns keeps the views portable and reviewable without needing to know that rule.

## Risks
